title: A dashboard isn't an agentic OS: cortextOS explained
description: A nice Claude Code dashboard with a one-click skill and a usage meter is not an agentic OS. It's a dashboard. A real agentic OS runs your coding agents 24/7, lets you message them from your phone, and has them talk to each other and self-improve while you sleep. That's what I built with cortextOS. The whole thing is hosted for install in my community and members are improving the repo with me. Link in bio.
